name: MPI Volume Rendering (3D Decomposition)
definition: Parallel volume rendering using MPI with 3D spatial decomposition, where the volume is split into a 3D grid of subdomains and each process receives a contiguous chunk to ray cast independently.
summary: MPI Volume Rendering (3D Decomposition) partitions 3D datasets into subdomains for parallel ray casting, distinguishing itself by splitting data along X, Y, and Z axes simultaneously to match process grids.
